sql:
SELECT ProductCategoryName, ProductSubcategoryName, SalesAmount
FROM (
  SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName AS ProductCategoryName,
         ps.ProductSubcategoryName AS ProductSubcategoryName,
         sum(f.SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pc.ProductCategoryKey ORDER BY sum(f.SalesAmount) DESC) AS rn
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
  JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
  JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
  JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
  WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
  GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryKey, pc.ProductCategoryName, ps.ProductSubcategoryName
)
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY SalesAmount DESC
